title: Distctl
description: distctl.py - build the distribution zips, write the managed .gitignore block, and export a clean public copy. The managed ignore block ignores session.json, HANDOFF.md and needs-human.json; LEGAL_FILES (LICENSE, NOTICE) ship inside .claude/ of both kits. A GITATTRIBUTES constant (eol=lf rules) ships at both kits' roots, and the managed .gitignore block also ignores .cview/ in both visibilities.
